tools.name: execute_test_suite
tools.description: Executes all Playwright tests in the project and returns the output to the console.

tools.name: analyze_logs
tools.description: Reads the latest test results from the test-results directory for failure analysis.

tools.name: generate_report
tools.description: Generates an Allure Report and prepares a link for viewing.
tools.command: npx allure generate --clean && npx allure open
